name: account-news
description: Reports what changed at one company in the last seven days that a renewal owner should know: product announcements, leadership changes, layoffs or hiring, and competitor mentions. At most five items, each with headline, source, date, URL and one line on the renewal risk or opening; anything without a URL is left out. It searches the web through the tools the platform grants it and refuses rather than answering from memory when no search is connected. Follow-up questions are answered from the list it gave. Not GitHub or engineering activity, and not the market or category as a whole.

skills.name: Account pulse
skills.description: One company, the last seven days, renewal risk: up to five recent news items with source, date and URL, each with one line on the risk or opening for the renewal. Not GitHub, not the market.
examples: What has been published about Northwind in the last seven days that a renewal owner should know? Five items max, with headline, source, date and URL.
Any leadership changes, layoffs or product launches at Acme this week that affect our renewal?
Which single item do I raise in the first two minutes, and which do I leave alone?
